Creates placeholder videos and triggers the appropriate generation tasks:
- blackout_sora2: Uses create_kie_talking_video_task (requires product_id)
- hook_variation: Uses create_hook_variation_task (requires product_id and ADS videos)
- sora2: Uses create_kie_trending_video_task (requires product_id)
- minimal_variation: Uses create_minimal_variation_task (requires existing videos)

2. Set product.is_active = False

4. Set auto_schedule_settings.is_enabled = False
5. Clear scheduled queue entries for this product
6. Keep agent assignments active (will transfer to new product later)

1. Check credits (REQUIRED_CREDITS = 10)
2. Verify user owns OnboardingData with context='reset_product'
3. Get old_product_id from OnboardingData
4. Deduct credits
5. Create new Product from scraped data
6. Transfer agents from old_product to new product
7. Create auto_schedule_settings (disabled)
8. Create 10 placeholder videos + queue entries
9. Trigger video_orchestrator_v6_task
10. Trigger enrich_product_v6_task

get.description:
Return device-level failures detected by Vireel that need ADB recovery.

Each item contains:
  id        — source record UUID (used in /resolve)
  table     — "stats_refresh_issue" | "social_comment_queue"
  serial    — ADB serial so the watchdog can call device_recovery.py directly
  issue_num — device_recovery.py --issue number
  incident_type — canonical incident key for PFA AI sync matching
  fingerprint — stable item key used for late AI patching/matching
  platform  — "tiktok" | "instagram" | "" (passed to device_recovery.py --platform)
  agent_id  — PFA agent_id (informational)

post.description:
Mark a recovery item as handled by the watchdog.

social_comment_queue + passed=True:
    Resets status → "scheduled" (5 min delay) so the scheduler retries dispatch.

stats_refresh_issue:
    No state change needed — Vireel's stats retry scheduler runs independently
    and will succeed now that the device is healthy.
